title: Facet force at L1-L2 - Sawa AGU, Crawford NR 2008 (J Biomech 41:2647) (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: facet load from extra-articular strain gauges + neural network; mean +/- SD; flexion/extension = mean of facets; AR and LB split ipsilateral/contralateral

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.n: not stated in review (see primary: Sawa AGU, Crawford NR 2008 (J Biomech 41:2647))
source.sample: human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Sawa AGU, Crawford NR 2008 (J Biomech 41:2647), as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 2

protocol.summary: Pure moments 7.5 Nm; facet force estimated from extra-articular strain gauges.
how_to_simulate: Report facet force at L1-L2 (mean of both facets in flexion/extension; ipsi/contralateral in AR and LB)
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (the user's own review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Sawa AGU, Crawford NR 2008 (J Biomech 41:2647).

extraction.from: Table 2 (summary of in vitro facet force measurements)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 2 image (page 5, 200 dpi): every value, +/-, min/max, units and level labels match the pdftotext output.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD (mean+/-SD) or min <= model <= max (ranges); widen for facet-force method bias (Wilson 2006)

shared_sample_with: sawa2008: primary (fe_facet tests from Sawa2008.pdf, other fork)
